name: @vssaros/dsh-scheduler
description: VsSaros Scheduler module for DeepSeek Harness. Host side: self-built schedule engine (occupies the `schedule` service key; tasks live in <dataRoot>/scheduler/tasks.json) served over /x/scheduler/api/*, and **onFire is now wired to delivery** (bridge vssarosRuns.run, same primitive as vssaros-loop) so a due task actually posts its prompt into the bound session instead of only writing history. Client side: ONE workbench with two tabs — 任务 (scheduled tasks + runtime loops mixed) and 运行记录. Loops come from @vssaros/dsh-loop same-origin routes; when absent the tab degrades to scheduled-task-only. Model side: schedule_create auto-binds the calling session (exec.agent.session.id) and accepts time:"HH:MM" instead of minute numbers.
